messages.text: Map the chain from a Automotive market requirement to a measurable parameter and then to a required capability of Vector Network Analyzer.

### Chain map
| Chain step | Supported fact | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Automotive market requirement | Automotive SerDes Alliance standards are used for in-vehicle high-speed data links. | [46] |
| Technical measurement need | High-speed PCB/PCBA signal-integrity flow includes IL, Xtalk, Eye diagram, TDR impedance, Stackup Planner and TL Calculator. | [30] |
| PCB measurable parameters | R&S PCB test solutions list Material/Stackup selection parameters including IL, DK/DF, roughness, impedance, Xtalk, TL modeling and Eye diagram. | [55] |
| VNA-required capability | R&S ZNA is a Vector Network Analyzer series covering ZNA26, ZNA43, ZNA50 and ZNA67, with frequency range from 10 MHz up to 67 GHz. | [62] |
| VNA-required capability | R&S ZNA key performance includes dynamic range >129 dB without options, 147 dB typical with options, and maximum attainable range up to 170 dB allowing full 2-port correction. | [8] |
| VNA-required capability | R&S ZNA supports measurement bandwidth from 1 Hz to 1.5 MHz on the base unit, or 1 Hz to 30 MHz with the ZNA-K17 increased IF bandwidth option on ZNA26 and ZNA43. | [71][75] |
| VNA-required capability | R&S ZNA offers time-domain-adjacent and SI-relevant capabilities listed as Time domain analysis and Deembedding among key concepts. | [57] |
### Mapped chain
Automotive in-vehicle high-speed data links → PCB/channel SI parameters such as insertion loss, crosstalk, eye diagram and TDR impedance → VNA capability requiring sufficient frequency coverage, dynamic range, measurement bandwidth, and calibration/deembedding support. [46][30][55][62][8][71][75][57]
【推論】For an Automotive SerDes PCB/channel use case, the measurable VNA-facing parameters most directly supported by the passages are insertion loss, return/reflection-related behavior, crosstalk and impedance, because the sources link high-speed PCB/PCBA SI flow to IL/Xtalk/Eye/TDR impedance and list R&S PCB test solution parameters including IL, impedance and Xtalk. [30][55]
【推論】The VNA capability chain can be mapped to R&S ZNA frequency range up to 67 GHz, high dynamic range, selectable measurement bandwidth, and deembedding/time-domain-related functions, but the passages do not directly state an Automotive-specific R&S ZNA configuration. [62][8][71][75][57]

ZNA_specs_en_5215-4652-22_v2400 › 規格條件與資料定義
- Specifications with limits：表示 warranted product performance；以 <、≤、>、≥、±、maximum、limit of、minimum 等符號標示；compliance 由 testing 確保或由 design 推導。
- Non-traceable specifications with limits（n. trc.）：依 specifications with limits 指定與測試，但因缺乏可追溯至 national metrology standards 的 measuring equipment，product performance 不保證。
- Specifications without limits：表示 warranted product performance；未特別標記時表示數值沒有或只有可忽略偏差。
- Typical data（typ.）：representative information；若標示 <、> 或 range，代表約 80% instruments 在 production time 可達成的 performance，其他情況代表 mean value。
- Nominal values（nom.）：representative value；production 期間不測試該 parameter。
- Measured values（meas.）：individual samples 的 measurement results。
- Uncertainties：coverage factor 2，依 Guide to the Expression of Uncertainty in Measurement（GUM），並考量 environmental conditions、aging、wear and tear。
- 來源明確說明：non-traceable specifications with limits、typical data、nominal values、measured values 不由 Rohde & Schwarz 保證。

R&S ZNA › Key performance（Version 24.00）
- Dynamic range：> 129 dB specification without options；147 dB typical with options；maximum attainable range up to 170 dB allowing full 2-port correction。
- Sensitivity：> –120 dBm，1 Hz IF bandwidth，specification without options；–162 dBm，1 Hz IF bandwidth，measured with options。來源註明 –162 dBm 是以 1 kHz measurement bandwidth 量測後 normalized to 1 Hz。
- Power sweep range：100 dB typical continuous electronic sweep range；可使用 mechanical step attenuators 位移 sweep range。
- Source power linearity：0.2 dB typical，範圍 –40 dBm to +10 dBm。
- Receiver compression：0.05 dB typical，up to +8 dBm at test port，referenced to –10 dBm。
- Trace noise：0.005 dB specification RMS、0.002 dB typical RMS，條件為 10 GHz、100 kHz measurement bandwidth、0 dB reflection。
- Speed example：10 MHz to 43.5 GHz、500 kHz measurement bandwidth、1601 points、2-port calibration 時 sweep time 96 ms nominal。

- [[AI Server PCB test image 24]] 未定義 Dk 與 Df 的完整名稱、測試頻率、測試方法、量測標準或條件。
- [[AI Server PCB test image 24]] 未提供任何 Dk 或 Df 數值。
- [[AI Server PCB test image 24]] 未標示材料樣本、基材牌號、層壓板型號或供應商。
- [[HSD PCB image 15]] 未提供 [[DK]] 或 [[Low DK]] 的數值門檻、測試頻率、測試方法、厚度範圍或標準版本。
- [[HSD PCB image 15]] 未說明 [[Low DK 玻纖布]] 的主要台廠註記是否等同供應商、主要市場參與者、概念股或其他口徑。
- [[HSD PCB image 18]] 未提供 [[Low Dk]] / [[Low Df]] 的數值門檻、測試頻率、測試方法、厚度範圍、產品型號、標準版本或價格。
- [[HSD PCB image 18]] 的「AI/5G 標配」是未標示日期圖卡的說法；不得推論 [[富喬]] 或 [[台玻]] 已量產、出貨或取得特定 AI / 5G 客戶認證。
- [[snla426]] 的 Df / εr / SDD21 表格是 TI application note 中的 high-speed PCB design reference；來源摘要未提供測試結構、trace geometry、stack-up、銅粗糙度、溫度、濕度或 measurement / simulation 條件。

Dk-Df › 來源中的說法
- [[AI Server PCB test image 24]]（來源未標示日期；取得於 2026-09-04）在原材料表徵階段寫明「测量原材料（如基材或层压板）的 Dk/Df」。
- [[AI Server PCB test image 24]]（來源未標示日期；取得於 2026-09-04）在材料選擇階段寫明「测量插入损耗、表面粗糙度和材料特性（Dk/Df）」。
- [[AI Server PCB test image 24]]（來源未標示日期；取得於 2026-09-04）在電路板抽樣測試階段寫明「测量插入损耗、阻抗变化和材料特性（Dk/Df）」。
- [[AI Server PCB test image 24]]（來源未標示日期；取得於 2026-09-04）在解決方案區塊寫明「基于 ENA/PNA 的 Delta-L 损耗、TDR 阻抗测量和 Dk/Df 提取」。
- [[HSD PCB image 15]]（來源未標示日期；取得於 2026-09-04）稱[[玻纖布]]可依據[[介電係數]]（[[DK]]）和厚度做綜合等級區分。
- [[HSD PCB image 15]]（來源未標示日期；取得於 2026-09-04）稱常聽到的 [[Low DK]] 是玻纖布材質低介電 / 低延遲的意思。
- [[HSD PCB image 15]]（來源未標示日期；取得於 2026-09-04）將 [[Low DK 玻纖布]]列為次高階玻纖布，用途 / 特性欄為「高頻高速PCB板材、伺服器、車用、通訊」。
- [[HSD PCB image 18]]（來源未標示日期；取得於 2026-09-04）在材料演進階梯中把 [[Low Dk]] / [[Low Df]] 標為「低損耗」，並寫「降低訊號損耗，AI/5G 標配（[[富喬]]、[[台玻]] 主力衝刺區）。」
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 Loss tangent（Df）或 Dissipation Factor 是 signal 沿 transmission line 傳播時 signal attenuation 的量測。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 dielectric loss 來自 dielectric material 對 electromagnetic wave 的吸收；frequency 增加時，dielectric loss 也成比例增加。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 ultra-low loss materials 的 Df 通常範圍為 0.02 到 0.001；較小的 Df 會造成較低 signal attenuation；[[PCIe]] 等 high speed applications 需要低 Df。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 [[fiberglass weave]] 的 εr 約為 6，[[epoxy]] 的 εr 約為 3；fiber glass laminate 中的 holes 或 openings 會造成 εr 與 Df 差異。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 εr 與 Df 差異會在 signal bandwidth 的不同頻率上造成 transmission media 的 [[return loss]] 或 [[insertion loss]] resonance / anti-resonance。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 εr 通常範圍為 2.5 到 4.5，並隨 frequency 變化；frequency 增加時 εr 下降。

- Specifications 適用於 10 Hz measurement bandwidth，without user correction applied。

### Chain map
| Chain step | Supported fact | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Automotive market requirement | Automotive SerDes Alliance standards are used for in-vehicle high-speed data links. | [46] |
| Technical measurement need | High-speed PCB/PCBA signal-integrity flow includes IL, Xtalk, Eye diagram, TDR impedance, Stackup Planner and TL Calculator. | [30] |

| VNA-required capability | R&S ZNA is a Vector Network Analyzer series covering ZNA26, ZNA43, ZNA50 and ZNA67, with frequency range from 10 MHz up to 67 GHz. | [62] |
| VNA-required capability | R&S ZNA key performance includes dynamic range >129 dB without options, 147 dB typical with options, and maximum attainable range up to 170 dB allowing full 2-port correction. | [8] |
| VNA-required capability | R&S ZNA supports measurement bandwidth from 1 Hz to 1.5 MHz on the base unit, or 1 Hz to 30 MHz with the ZNA-K17 increased IF bandwidth option on ZNA26 and ZNA43. | [71][75] |
| VNA-required capability | R&S ZNA offers time-domain-adjacent and SI-relevant capabilities listed as Time domain analysis and Deembedding among key concepts. | [57] |
### Mapped chain
Automotive in-vehicle high-speed data links → PCB/channel SI parameters such as insertion loss, crosstalk, eye diagram and TDR impedance → VNA capability requiring sufficient frequency coverage, dynamic range, measurement bandwidth, and calibration/deembedding support. [46][30][55][62][8][71][75][57]
【推論】For an Automotive SerDes PCB/channel use case, the measurable VNA-facing parameters most directly supported by the passages are insertion loss, return/reflection-related behavior, crosstalk and impedance, because the sources link high-speed PCB/PCBA SI flow to IL/Xtalk/Eye/TDR impedance and list R&S PCB test solution parameters including IL, impedance and Xtalk. [30][55]
【推論】The VNA capability chain can be mapped to R&S ZNA frequency range up to 67 GHz, high dynamic range, selectable measurement bandwidth, and deembedding/time-domain-related functions, but the passages do not directly state an Automotive-specific R&S ZNA configuration. [62][8][71][75][57]
